{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows strong bearish signals (e.g., sentiment < 0.00).",
    "Increase forecast bias toward true outcome when recent history shows strong upward momentum (e.g., 3-5 consecutive high true values).",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp spikes in true values — apply a dampening factor (e.g., 0.8x) to model’s immediate next forecast.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if model consistently overpredicts in trending markets — use 30-day moving average as baseline.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when true values deviate significantly from historical mean — especially if sentiment is positive and true values are below forecast.",
    "Correct for lagged response: if true outcome is rising, delay forecast adjustment by 1-2 periods unless sentiment confirms momentum.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or mixed, favor historical volatility-adjusted mean over model’s trend projection."
  ]
}
